name: Nonohana Main
source:
Sister of the main character. A patient with Nosfera disease who has just been admitted to St. ReiKura clinic. She has a muscle disease in both legs and cannot walk, so she is in a wheelchair.

She is incredibly attached to her brother and often shows hostility towards Akari, her brother's girlfriend. She actually likes and even respects Akari, but rarely shows it.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=763771]Getchu[/url]]
